name: Genesis of Starsigns
description:
Combat Action: When your active character is Mona, equip this card.
After Mona equips this card, your next Vaporize Reaction deals +2 DMG and immediately use Ripple of Fate once.
When Mona uses a Normal Attack, spend 1 fewer Unaligned Element. After the Normal Attack, your next Vaporize Reaction deals +2 DMG.
(You must have Mona in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
